query:
-- Easter 2025 was April 20, 2025 — week starting April 20 (Sunday)
SELECT weekStartDate, campus, subgroup, headcount, regularCount, guestCount, volunteerCount
FROM attendance_weekly
WHERE weekStartDate = '2025-04-20'
ORDER BY campus, subgroup;
